Scènes d'Intérieur.title: Diva Vénitienne
Scènes d'Intérieur.description: An orchestra with a red-draped Diva stands out against the architecture of a baroque theatre through which the silhouette of the Salute in Venice can be glimpsed.

Scènes d'Intérieur.title: Duo au piano
Scènes d'Intérieur.description: The silhouettes of two musicians contrast with the forms of collaged papers subtly highlighted with gold.

Scènes d'Intérieur.title: Confidences des deux amies
Scènes d'Intérieur.description: Two friends chatting away in the warm atmosphere of a Parisian café.

Scènes d'Intérieur.title: Conversation à Saint-Germain-des-Prés
Scènes d'Intérieur.description: This café on the corner of Rue de Buci in Paris creates reflections and perspectives in constant movement.

Scènes d'Intérieur.title: Autour d'un verre à Venise (diptyque)
Scènes d'Intérieur.description: A diptych composition evoking both the interior of a baroque café and a perspective on the Salute, the Thames and Venetian barques.

Scènes d'Intérieur.title: Le Temps Suspendu
Scènes d'Intérieur.description: This canvas depicts the restaurant 'La Cigale' in Nantes with its cicada-decorated ceramics, ornate décor and mirrors creating artful reflections.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: Pause Apéritive (diptyque)
Terrasses et Marchés.description: In this diptych composition, the main harmonies are blue and orange, complementary colours punctuated with white and subtle warm green nuances.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: Terrasse Ombragée
Terrasses et Marchés.description: A Provençal restaurant enhanced with a fountain. The nuanced blue of the shopfront contrasts with the sun-drenched façade in orange tones, bringing warmth, vitality and energy to the canvas.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: Détente à Gordes
Terrasses et Marchés.description: Majestic trees dominate the square of this restaurant in Gordes, creating shifting plays of shadow and light.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: La Marchande de Légumes
Terrasses et Marchés.description: Colourful parasols seem to dance and punctuate the composition. Vegetables in multiple colours occupy the foreground of the canvas, forming a diagonal. Figures bring the scene to life.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: En Terrasse Parmi Les fleurs
Terrasses et Marchés.description: A lively scene of everyday life. Café terrace, waiter, flowers and blue sky. The whole in the shimmering colours of Provence.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: À la Terrasse du Fournil
Terrasses et Marchés.description: A café terrace scene gently transitioning from shadow to light.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: Pause Apéritive au Soleil Provençal
Terrasses et Marchés.description: Colourful fruits on a market stall alongside a café terrace, bathed in contrasting blue nuances.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: Promenade d'été en famille à Roussillon
Terrasses et Marchés.description: Children playing with fountain water under the watchful eyes of parents enjoying the moment on a terrace.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: Les Heures Douces à la Fontaine
Terrasses et Marchés.description: Serenity on a terrace with a view of colourful fields to the murmur of the fountain.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: Détente au Jardin
Terrasses et Marchés.description: A summer family meal in the garden beneath the sheltering branches of a lime tree.

Terrasses et Marchés.title: Le Marché de Roussillon
Terrasses et Marchés.description: A market rendered in warm colours with touches of various luminous greens in contrast.

Paysages.title: Roussillon aux fleurs sauvages
Paysages.description: Bursts of colourful touches flying in the wind contrast with the static aspect of the ochre houses of Roussillon.

Paysages.title: Camargue Secrète
Paysages.description: This dynamically worked canvas, using brush and palette knife, is a subtle combination of cool and warm tones. The flooded expanses of the Camargue, in shades of blue, contrast with a yellow foreground highlighted with touches of pink.

Paysages.title: Reflets Émeraude
Paysages.description: A subtle contrast between the turquoise waters of the canal and the yellow and orange ochre façades of the houses.

Paysages.title: Symphonie Automnale
Paysages.description: Painted predominantly in warm tones of plum, orange and yellow, this canvas is enlivened by subtle touches of violet and lime green bringing dynamism to the composition.

Paysages.title: Paysage Pourpre et Vermillon
Paysages.description: A diagonal separating two areas of yellow and orange flat tint brings dynamism to this canvas, punctuated by a contrasting emerald green.

Paysages.title: Roussillon au Soleil Joyeux
Paysages.description: In this warmly toned canvas of yellow, orange and red, palette knife texture effects punctuate the composition with their dynamism.

Paysages.title: Printemps à Bonnieux
Paysages.description: This canvas evokes spring in Bonnieux, a village in the Luberon. Its cherry blossoms contrast with the foreground worked with palette knife in tones of yellow, orange and red.

Paysages.title: De Pourpre et d'Azur
Paysages.description: The village of Roussillon and its bell tower form the subject of this canvas. The houses are rendered in shades of yellow, orange and rosy red. Touches of green symbolically represent the trees.

Paysages.title: Les Vignes de Bonnieux
Paysages.description: In this canvas, a diagonal punctuates the composition, separating a flat yellow area from the vines rendered with multicoloured touches.

Paysages.title: Gordes aux Iris
Paysages.description: Irises with their foliage stand dynamically in the foreground. The village's white stones and golden fields appear in the contrasting background.

Paysages.title: Dune dans le Vent
Paysages.description: Worked with palette knife and pigments for texture and material effects, this canvas offers gradients of orange-yellow and blue-green that give an impression of space and infinity.

Paysages.title: Parfums Secrets de Provence
Paysages.description: In this canvas, the lightness of the vines rendered in multicoloured touches contrasts with the flat areas of coloured fields and three trees in faded pink tones. Two figures dressed in white animate the scene in the heart of the vineyard.

Paysages.title: Champs d'Herbes Sauvages
Paysages.description: This luminous canvas with warm dominant tones stands out with its striking reds and yellows while colourful touches underline the verticality of the wild grasses in the foreground.

Paysages.title: Paysage Pourpre et Vermillon au Soleil Couchant
Paysages.description: A foreground of vines with multicoloured touches contrasts with flat tints of pink, vermilion and yellow. The verticality of one of the vine stakes accentuates that of the church of Bonnieux in the background.

Collection aquarelles.title: Au large des calanques de Cassis
Village au loin au coeur des lavandes
Le temps d'un apéritif en Provence
